earnings.title: Palo Alto Networks Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Financial Results
highlights: Total revenue for the fiscal first quarter 2027 grew 39% year over year to $3.44 billion.
GAAP operating income for the fiscal first quarter 2027 was $96 million, compared with GAAP operating income of $309 million for the fiscal first quarter 2026.
Non-GAAP operating income for the fiscal first quarter 2027 was $1.1 billion, compared with non-GAAP operating income of $746 million for the fiscal first quarter 2026.

GAAP net income for the fiscal first quarter 2027 was $482 million, or $0.57 per diluted share, compared with GAAP net income of $334 million, or $0.47 per diluted share, for the fiscal first quarter 2026.

Non-GAAP net income for the fiscal first quarter 2027 was $881 million, or $1.05 per diluted share, compared with non-GAAP net income of $662 million, or $0.93 per diluted share, for the fiscal first quarter 2026.

quotes.text: We had a strong start to the year with a record Q1 and delivered one of our highest NGS ARR beats ever as our customers turn to us to protect them against an unprecedented threat environment.
quotes.by: Nikesh Arora, chairman and chief executive officer of Palo Alto Networks

quotes.text: We delivered a very strong start to the year, in what is typically a seasonally slower Q1, fueled by acceleration across each of our segments.
quotes.by: Dipak Golechha, chief financial officer of Palo Alto Networks

outlook: Next-Generation Security ARR of $10.20 billion to $10.22 billion, representing year-over-year growth of 61%.
Remaining performance obligations of $21.5 billion to $21.6 billion, representing year-over-year growth of 34% to 35%.
Total revenue in the range of $3.530 billion to $3.550 billion, representing year-over-year growth of 36% to 37%.
Diluted non-GAAP net income per share in the range of $1.01 to $1.03, using 837 million to 842 million shares outstanding.

items.heading: Our operating results may be adversely affected by unfavorable economic and market conditions and the uncertain geopolitical environment.
items.group: Risks Related to Global Economic and Geopolitical Conditions

items.heading: Our business and operations have experienced growth in recent periods, and if we do not effectively manage our future growth or are unable to improve our systems, processes, and controls, our business and operating results could be adversely affected.

Our revenue growth rate in recent periods may not be indicative of our future performance, and we may not be able to maintain profitability, which could cause our business, financial condition, and operating results to suffer.

Our operating results may vary significantly from period to period, including due to seasonality, which makes our results difficult to predict and could cause our results to fall short of expectations.

If we are unable to sell new and additional products, subscriptions, and support offerings to existing end-customers or attract new customers, especially large enterprise customers, our future revenue and operating results will be harmed.
items.group: RISKS RELATED TO OUR PRODUCTS AND TECHNOLOGY

items.heading: Our consumption- or usage-based offerings may expose us to customer usage optimization behavior that could create revenue volatility.
